title: Blue Marble (2002): Land Surface, Ocean Color, Sea Ice, and Clouds
credit: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center; Reto Stöckli and Robert Simmon
usage: NASA imagery, public domain in the United States unless otherwise indicated. The source article makes these images freely available to the public. Credit retained; no endorsement implied.
processing: Original JPEG retained. Seven levels per color channel applied in the runtime shader; three lighting bands. Earth and Moon are deliberately enlarged scenery.
